name: GameWatch
author: TheD3v_
short: Per-game server status and patch notes cog for Red-DiscordBot.
description: Repository containing GameWatch, a Red-DiscordBot cog that tracks live server status and patch notes for League of Legends, Teamfight Tactics, VALORANT, Counter-Strike 2, Escape from Tarkov, ARC Raiders, Arena Breakout: Infinite, and ROB RUN.
install_msg:
Thanks for adding the GameWatch repository!
Install the cog with `[p]cog install gamewatch gamewatch` and load it with `[p]load gamewatch`.
